name: Breasail
text: Breasail is a variant spelling of Brasil. Brasil names the phantom isle. The isle is far better known as Hy-Brasil, and the reader should follow the Brasil entry for the fuller account.

okr.objective: Explain the spelling Breasail and direct the reader to the Brasil entry.
key_results: Breasail is an alternative spelling of Brasil.
Brasil names the phantom isle Hy-Brasil.
The full account sits under the name Brasil.
